mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiredCount, COALESCE(SUM(file_size_bytes), 0) AS totalSizeBytes, COALESCE(AVG(duration_ms), 0) AS avgDurationMs, MAX(create_time) AS latestBackupTime FROM data_backup_record WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalBackups, COALESCE(SUM(file_size_bytes), 0) AS totalSizeBytes, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN file_size_bytes ELSE 0 END), 0) AS availableSizeBytes, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(file_size_bytes), 0) / NULLIF( (SELECT setting_value FROM sys_setting WHERE setting_key = 'backup.storage.max_size'), 1 ) * 100, 2) END AS usagePercent, MIN(create_time) AS oldestBackupTime, MAX(create_time) AS latestBackupTime, SUM(CASE WHEN expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '7 days' AND status = 2 AND deleted = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS expiringSoonCount FROM data_backup_record WHERE deleted = 0
SELECT * FROM data_backup_record WHERE expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= NOW() + INTERVAL '#{days} days' AND status = 2 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY expires_at ASC LIMIT 50
SELECT * FROM data_backup_record WHERE (expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at < NOW() OR retention_days > 0) AND status IN (2, 4) AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY expires_at ASC LIMIT 100

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS inProgressCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS successCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS failedCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS expiredCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS deletingCount FROM data_backup_record WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COUNT(*) AS count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successCount, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failedCount, COALESCE(SUM(file_size_bytes), 0) AS totalSize FROM data_backup_record WHERE deleted = 0 AND create_time >= DATE_TRUNC('month', NOW() - INTERVAL '#{months} months') GROUP BY TO_CHAR(create_time, 'YYYY-MM') ORDER BY month DESC LIMIT #{months}
SELECT * FROM data_backup_record WHERE status = 2 AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
